question: Can theme-valid institutional bottlenecks reduce Demis and Jensen standings while preserving Demis's technical progress and Jensen's Compute abundance and supplier leverage?

demis.protectedStrength: Starting Compute, Research reliability, and all Capability banked by Scientific Method remain unchanged.
demis.bottleneck: A rescued run adds public Scrutiny only when the protection is actually consumed.
demis.eligibility: Reject the candidate if it suppresses Capability, Research selection, or Scientific Method use rather than pricing public validation.

foundry.protectedStrength: Starting Compute, rival license offers, licensing revenue, and the maximum three-Compute New Architecture remain available.
foundry.bottleneck: New Architecture grants one base Compute plus one per accepted rival license, capped at the canonical three.
foundry.eligibility: Reject the candidate if it erases supplier transactions, makes the maximum unattainable, or fails to relate self-supply to realized rival demand.

requiredDiagnostics: configuration-specific faction win share, mean Mandate, and mean rank by player count
configuration-specific faction audit hits and forced no-ops
Scientific Method uses, Capability preserved, Scrutiny added, and Research selections
New Architecture uses, self Compute gained, licenses sold, rival Compute granted, and Runway gained
paired faction win-share, score, and rank delta

selectionRule.demis: Select only if four-player standings move materially toward parity, three and five remain bounded, Capability is unchanged, and the correction is realized through Scrutiny rather than weaker science.
selectionRule.foundry: Select only if Foundry moves materially toward parity across supported counts while accepted licenses still create both supplier revenue and a credible path to the full three Compute.
selectionRule.pairedAuthority: Compare each candidate only with canonical under common seeds. Positive paired rankDelta means improved placement.
selectionRule.integrity: Any integrity violation, policy fallback, unsupported-count gap, missing configuration-specific faction standing, or missing realized-ability accounting rejects the probe.
selectionRule.promotion: No physical text changes without a tracked receipt, complete surface audit, a new immutable candidate, and explicit user approval.
